title: Verbal Prefixes 8: Mixed Review with One Root, Many Prefixes
titleRussian: Глагольные приставки 8: Итоговое повторение — один корень, много приставок
description: Synthesis of the prefix track. Same root + different prefixes give a family of perfectives with different meanings. The lesson asks the learner to NAME the prefix shade operating in each sentence and produce the matching form.
descriptionRussian: Итоговое повторение трека. Один корень с разными приставками даёт семейство совершенных глаголов с разными значениями. Урок учит называть, какая приставочная схема работает в каждом предложении, и образовывать нужную форму.
intro: Six different prefixes on a single root, side by side. The claim this makes is about reading: a learner who can see the root through the prefix stops needing a dictionary for a whole class of words, because the prefix narrows the meaning predictably enough to guess from. That is worth more than being able to produce them.
rules: Same root + different prefixes = a family of perfectives with different meanings. Читать → прочитать / перечитать / дочитать.

Each prefix carries its shades from earlier lessons: пере- (across / redo / exceed), до- (finish), вы- (out / exhaust / complete), раз- (apart / fully / intensify), при- (arrival / slightly / bring), за- (start / drop by / state).
Recognising the prefix is the reading unlock. A learner who parses прочитал vs перечитал vs дочитал reads with confidence.
To choose a form, work in steps: root → prefix → typical shades → context fit → aspect (perfective by default) → agreement → meaning check.
A prefixed root is perfective by default, so it names a single completed event, not an ongoing process.
examples: Антон прочитал книгу за два дня. (Anton read the book through in two days.) Про-: through cover to cover.
Я перечитал письмо несколько раз. (I (m) reread the letter several times.) Пере-: redo.
Маша дочитала роман к утру. (Masha finished reading the novel by morning.) До-: finish what was in progress.
Лена выпила весь сок. (Lena drank up all the juice.) Вы-: consume to nothing.
Антон разбил чашку, когда мыл посуду. (Anton broke the cup while washing dishes.) Раз-: full breakage.
Маша приоткрыла окно, чтобы проветрить комнату. (Masha opened the window a crack to air the room.) При-: partial action.

cells: finish what was started, reach endpoint

tables.title: One root, several prefixes: читать and делать

items.prompt: Маша _____ окно перед сном. (warm-up from Lesson 7)
items.promptEnglish: Masha closed the window before bed.
items.hint: Recap from Lesson 7: achieved the closed state. Which prefix?
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 7: 'closed the window' achieves a definite state, the за- shade for reaching a state → закрыла.

items.prompt: Я _____ это письмо ещё раз, потому что забыл, что в нём.
items.promptEnglish: I (m) reread this letter again because I forgot what was in it.
items.hint: 'Ещё раз' = repeated reading. Which prefix marks redo?
items.explanation: 'Ещё раз' (one more time) signals the пере- redo shade: перечитал, a repeat reading from the start.

items.prompt: Антон _____ всё молоко из кружки и поставил её на стол.
items.promptEnglish: Anton drank all the milk from the mug and put it on the table.
items.explanation: 'Всё молоко' (all the milk) plus putting the now-empty mug down signals the вы- shade 'consume up to nothing' → выпил.

items.prompt: Дети _____ до парка пешком за двадцать минут.
items.promptEnglish: The children walked all the way to the park in twenty minutes.
items.hint: До + gen 'до парка' + bounded time. Which prefix marks 'reach the endpoint'?
items.explanation: 'До + gen' (до парка) plus 'за двадцать минут' signals the до- shade 'reach the endpoint' → дошли.

items.prompt: Лена _____ марку на конверт перед отправкой.
items.promptEnglish: Lena stuck the stamp on the envelope before sending it off.
items.hint: Attached the stamp to the envelope. Which prefix marks attachment?
items.explanation: A stamp attached to an envelope signals the при- attachment shade → приклеила.

items.prompt: Маленькая девочка вдруг _____ от страха перед собакой.
items.promptEnglish: The little girl suddenly burst into tears from fear of the dog.
items.hint: 'Вдруг' = abrupt onset. Which prefix marks start of a process?
items.explanation: 'Вдруг' (suddenly) signals the за- shade 'start of a process' → заплакала, the canonical 'burst into tears.'

items.prompt: Лена _____ письмо ещё раз с самого начала.
items.promptEnglish: Lena reread the letter again from the start.
items.explanation: The redo shade is пере-: перечитала, a fresh reading from the very start.

items.prompt: Лена _____ домашнее задание, которое начала утром.
items.promptEnglish: Lena finished the homework she had started in the morning.
items.explanation: До- marks finishing what was in progress: доделала. The 'которое начала утром' clause frames a job already underway and carried to its end.

items.promptEnglish: Masha drank all the juice up, to the last drop.
items.explanation: Вы- marks consuming the whole supply: выпила весь сок. 'До капли' (to the last drop) is the consume-to-nothing cue.

items.promptEnglish: The little boy suddenly started laughing.
items.explanation: За- carries the onset: засмеялся ('suddenly started laughing'), with 'вдруг' as the abrupt-onset cue.

items.promptEnglish: Anton stuck the photo to the wall.
items.hint: Attaching one thing to another: which prefix?
items.explanation: При- marks attachment: приклеил к стене, one thing fastened onto another.

items.promptEnglish: Anton finally changed his mind and stayed home.
items.hint: 'Changed his mind' is a fixed пере- sense.
items.explanation: Пере- + думать gives the fixed sense 'change one's mind': передумал.

blanks: Антон _____ чашку, когда мыл посуду, и расстроился. (Anton broke the cup while washing dishes and was upset.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: 'Broke a cup while washing dishes' signals the раз- shade 'full destruction' → разбил (past, masculine, perfective).

errorCorrection.sentence: От злости Антон порвал письмо на мелкие кусочки.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Out of anger, Anton tore the letter into small pieces.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'На мелкие кусочки' (into small pieces) signals separation into parts, the раз- 'apart' shade: разорвал. Порвал means 'tore' without the into-pieces precision. Раз- plus 'на + acc' is the standard 'tear into many pieces.'

errorCorrection.sentence: Антон быстро понял новый номер телефона наизусть.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Anton quickly memorised the new phone number by heart.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Наизусть' (by heart) signals reaching the memorised state, the за- 'achieve a state' shade: запомнил. Понял means 'understood' (comprehension, not memorisation). За- on the memory root marks reaching the remembered state.

errorCorrection.sentence: Студент быстро написал статью с английского на русский.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: The student quickly translated the article from English into Russian.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'С английского на русский' (from English into Russian) signals moving the text across languages, the пере- 'across' shade (translate): перевёл. Написал means 'wrote from scratch', which the from-one-language-to-another frame contradicts.

minimalPairs.context: Я _____ статью три раза, чтобы понять её.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I (m) reread the article three times to understand it. (redo)
minimalPairs.explanation: 'Три раза' (three times) signals the пере- redo shade → перечитал. Дочитал would mean 'finished a reading in progress' (no repetition framing) and misses the 'read it through repeatedly' meaning.

minimalPairs.context: Маша _____ окно немного, чтобы было свежо.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Masha opened the window a bit so it would be fresh. (partial)
minimalPairs.explanation: 'Немного' (a little) signals the при- partial-action shade → приоткрыла. Открыла would be a full opening, which 'немного' contradicts.

patternRecognition.question: Which prefix shade is operating here?
patternRecognition.explanation: 'Три раза' (three times) is the cue for the пере- redo shade. The perfective form перечитал captures the repeated full reading, each one running cover to cover.

patternRecognition.sentence: Маша дочитала роман к утру и легла спать.
patternRecognition.question: Which prefix shade is operating here?
patternRecognition.explanation: The 'и легла спать' sequence implies the reading was already in progress and reached its endpoint by morning, the до- shade. The perfective form дочитала captures the reaching-the-endpoint moment, not the whole reading.

patternRecognition.sentence: Антон выпил весь чай за завтраком.
patternRecognition.question: Which prefix shade is operating here?
patternRecognition.explanation: 'Весь чай' (all the tea) is the cue for the вы- shade 'consume up to nothing.' The perfective form выпил captures the moment the cup ended up empty. The вы- stress shift onto the prefix is also a recognition signal.

patternRecognition.question: Which prefix shade is operating here?
patternRecognition.explanation: 'Вдруг' (suddenly) is the cue for the за- shade 'start a process.' The perfective form заплакала captures the moment of onset; the bare imperfective плакала would describe ongoing crying. With emotion and vocal verbs, за- consistently marks the onset.

reviewVocab.definition: the prefix system (the six prefixes that turn verbs perfective and add meaning shades; identifying the prefix is the B1 reading unlock)
reviewVocab.example: В семействе «прочитать / перечитать / дочитать» работает система приставок: один корень, разные оттенки.

reviewVocab.definition: family of prefixed verbs (one root supports several prefixed perfectives, each with its own shade; the choice depends on the speaker's exact meaning)
reviewVocab.example: Корень «дум-» даёт семейство «подумать / придумать / передумать»; каждая приставка добавляет свой оттенок.

reviewVocab.definition: the prefix shade (the specific meaning a prefix adds in a sentence: redo, finish, exhaust, attach, start, and so on; naming the shade locks in the right form)
reviewVocab.example: В слове «перечитал» оттенок приставки пере- — «сделать заново».
